research_scope: Base-game Parallel Quest skills from PQ 84-100 selected after screening against the canonical skill index and prior research batches. Non-skill rewards were excluded.

verification_audit.method: Skill identity, class, core cost data, and PQ acquisition routes were reconciled against current Xenoverse 2 skill references and independent PQ reward guides. Exact drop probabilities were not inferred.
verification_audit.source_conflicts: Where community documentation differs on whether a reward is an Ultimate Finish payout or an opponent drop, the distinction is recorded in mechanics_notes rather than converted into an unsupported probability claim.

records.name: Saiyan Spirit
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest reward; TP Medal Shop
records.skill_description: Attack with an ultimate fist full of Saiyan soul, followed by a Ki Wave when the initial attack connects.
records.mechanics_notes: 10-hit pseudo-strike/beam sequence; final Ki Wave leaves the opponent open. Exact drop probability unresolved.
records.combo_notes: Can be used during light-string routes and can create a follow-up ranged attack opportunity.
records.pve_notes: Long-range follow-up can be useful after the initial rush connects.
records.pvp_notes: The second portion can be evaded with appropriately timed evasives.

records.name: Neo Wolf Fang Fist
records.skill_description: A continuable rush that keeps attacking while the input is held.
records.mechanics_notes: 9-33 hit rushdown attack; holding the input continues the clawing sequence until released.
records.combo_notes: Continuable structure allows extension while Ki is available.
records.pvp_notes: Holding the attack increases commitment; release timing matters.

records.name: Atomic Blast
records.skill_description: Fire a chargeable Ki Wave with different damage behavior depending on charge timing and ground/air use.
records.mechanics_notes: No-charge, partial-charge and full-charge states have different damage/range properties. Exact drop probability unresolved.
records.combo_notes: Partial charge can be selected for stronger ground damage.
records.pve_notes: Flexible charge timing makes it useful at different ranges.
records.pvp_notes: Charge timing can be varied to avoid predictable firing patterns.

records.name: Buu Buu Ball
records.source_quest_or_shop: PQ88 - Evil Seeks Dragon Balls Yet Again!
records.skill_description: Roll into a ball and bounce while freely moving during the evasive sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: Three controllable bounces; can deal minor contact damage. Majin-only CaC restriction.
records.pve_notes: Useful for escaping pressure while retaining directional movement.
records.pvp_notes: Free movement during the bounce can alter positioning unpredictably.

records.name: Victory Rush
records.character_source: Trunks (GT); Trunks (Kid); Trunks (Future) Customize Partner; Gamma 2
records.dlc_requirement: Base game skill; later partner availability varies by update/DLC
records.source_quest_or_shop: PQ89 - Super-Super Ultimate Series of Battles!
records.skill_description: Teleporting rush Ultimate that ends with an axe kick.
records.mechanics_notes: 13-hit teleporting rush; total documented damage is about 20% in the referenced mechanics data. Exact drop probability unresolved.
records.combo_notes: Requires a suitable opening because the rush commits to a sequence.
records.pve_notes: Good close-range Ultimate when the target is locked down.
records.pvp_notes: Can be avoided if the opponent has enough freedom to use an evasive.

records.name: III Bomber
records.source_quest_or_shop: PQ90 - Gathering of the Great Evil Alliance
records.skill_description: Create an unblockable explosion, then hide from the opponent while moving invisibly.
records.mechanics_notes: Also documented as Ill Bomber/Revenge Death Bomber. Explosion is unblockable and invisibility lasts about 5 seconds in the cited mechanics data.
records.combo_notes: Best treated as a setup/utility attack rather than a conventional combo finisher.
records.pve_notes: Invisibility can provide repositioning after the explosion.
records.pvp_notes: Breaking lock-on can disrupt opponent tracking, but area attacks can still punish movement.

records.name: Final Kamehameha
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest reward; TP Medal Shop; Double Crystal Raids
records.skill_description: Fuse Final Flash and Super Kamehameha into a powerful long-range beam.
records.mechanics_notes: 22-hit beam in the cited mechanics data; exact drop probability unresolved.
records.combo_notes: Requires a strong opening such as a stamina break or long knockback.
records.pve_notes: High damage potential against immobilized targets.
records.pvp_notes: Startup makes setup important before attempting the beam.

records.name: Maiden Burst
records.dlc_requirement: Base game skill; Ribrianne is DLC
records.skill_description: Propel forward with a Ki explosion that counterattacks nearby opponents.
records.mechanics_notes: Single-hit short-range explosion; documented at 5% damage in the referenced mechanics data.
records.combo_notes: Primarily an escape/counter tool rather than a combo extender.
records.pvp_notes: Forward movement changes the evasive's positioning relative to the attacker.

records.name: Bluff Kamehameha
records.dlc_requirement: Base game skill; character availability varies
records.skill_description: A deceptive Kamehameha-style technique that drains the opponent's Ki without dealing direct damage.
records.mechanics_notes: Effect depends on the opponent's orientation and charge; Ki drain scales with Strike-based mechanics in legacy documentation. Exact drop probability unresolved.
records.combo_notes: Utility-oriented rather than a direct damage attack.
records.pve_notes: Can reduce enemy Ki and interfere with repeated Ultimate usage.
records.pvp_notes: Does not affect an opponent who has their back turned to the user according to legacy documentation.

records.name: Flash Bomber
records.dlc_requirement: Base game skill; partner availability varies by update
records.skill_description: Fire a barrage of Ki Blasts; holding the input extends the barrage by consuming additional Ki.
records.mechanics_notes: Base sequence is 21 hits; an additional 200 Ki can extend it to 56 hits in the cited mechanics data. Community testing identifies Flash Bomber as an Ultimate Finish payout.
records.combo_notes: Holding the input extends the sequence but increases Ki expenditure.
records.pve_notes: Extended barrage can provide sustained ranged damage.
records.pvp_notes: Long commitment creates a punish window if the opponent escapes the barrage.

records.name: Drain Field
records.dlc_requirement: Base game skill; later partner availability varies by update
records.source_quest_or_shop: PQ95 - Super 17, the Ultimate Android; Super 17 drop
records.skill_description: Absorb incoming Ki attacks and convert the interaction into energy/defensive utility.
records.mechanics_notes: Community documentation specifically identifies Super 17 as the skill-drop source and distinguishes Drain Field from Flash Bomber's Ultimate Finish reward.
records.combo_notes: Defensive utility; not a conventional combo attack.
records.pvp_notes: Requires reading the opponent's projectile timing.

records.name: Absolute Zero
records.character_source: Eis Shenron; Omega Shenron Customize Partner
records.dlc_requirement: Base game skill; partner availability varies
records.skill_description: Lower the user's body temperature and freeze attackers who strike during the stance.
records.mechanics_notes: Counter-style Evasive; attackers are frozen for about 3 seconds in the cited mechanics data.
records.combo_notes: Counter rather than a conventional combo action.
records.pvp_notes: Timing is central because the counter only activates when attacked during the stance.

records.name: Charged Ki Wave
records.skill_description: Exchange Ki for Stamina while performing a short recovery action.
records.mechanics_notes: Restores Stamina more quickly than Rise to Action but restores less; community testing identifies it as the PQ97 Ultimate Finish skill.
records.combo_notes: Recovery utility rather than direct damage.
records.pve_notes: Useful for restoring Stamina between enemy pressure windows.
records.pvp_notes: The recovery animation must be protected from interruption.

records.name: Phantom Fist
records.dlc_requirement: Base game skill; later character/customization availability varies
records.skill_description: A close-range utility attack associated with Hit and Mira.
records.mechanics_notes: Community testing identifies Phantom Fist as a Mira enemy drop rather than the PQ97 Ultimate Finish reward; exact cost and probability remain unresolved here.
records.combo_notes: Treat as a character-style utility Super until exact frame data is independently reconciled.
records.pve_notes: Enemy-drop acquisition should be distinguished from the separate Charged Ki Wave UF reward.
records.pvp_notes: Exact frame behavior is intentionally left unresolved in this batch.

records.name: Dimension Ray
records.dlc_requirement: Base game skill; character availability varies
records.skill_description: Fire numerous sharp Ki projectiles across a wide area.
records.mechanics_notes: 19-hit long-range barrage; documented at about 40% damage in the cited mechanics data.
records.combo_notes: Works best when the target cannot freely move.
records.pve_notes: Wide projectile coverage is useful against predictable movement.
records.pvp_notes: Spacing and tracking considerations matter because it is a long-range barrage.

records.name: Emperor's Edge
records.character_source: Golden Frieza; Golden Frieza (Supervillain); Frieza (1st Form) Customize Partner
records.skill_description: Slash the air to create a vertical explosion near the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Pseudo-Ki Blast Strike Super with long-range single-hit behavior. PQ99 reward mapping is corroborated by independent guides.
records.combo_notes: Single-hit launcher can be incorporated after suitable setup.
records.pve_notes: Longer range than a conventional Strike attack.
records.pvp_notes: Projectile-like presentation can affect spacing expectations, but it remains classified as Strike.

records.name: X100 Big Bang Kamehameha
records.dlc_requirement: Base game skill; later partner availability varies
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest reward; TP Medal Shop
records.skill_description: Fire a powerful Ki Wave and optionally sweep it side-to-side by disabling lock-on.
records.mechanics_notes: 24-hit mid-long-range beam. Community reports confirm RNG acquisition; exact probability and whether a particular finish path is mandatory are intentionally unresolved.
records.combo_notes: Best used after a reliable stamina break or other long opening.
records.pve_notes: High-damage ranged Ultimate with broad sweep potential when lock-on is disabled.
records.pvp_notes: Disabling lock-on changes the firing sweep and can be used for directional coverage.
